sources.entry: SwaprTrans - Lightweight (<2MB) native menu bar tool for select-and-space translation and in-place Enter rewrite, powered by Apple's on-device model. [![Open-Source Software][OSS Icon]](https://github.com/linrol/swapr-trans) ![Freeware][Freeware Icon]

summary.name: SwaprTrans
summary.one_liner: A lightweight native macOS menu bar tool that translates selected text on space and replaces it in place on Enter.
use_cases: translating messages in Slack, Teams or WeChat before sending
translating email drafts without switching windows
replacing selected text with a translation in a terminal or browser field
adding select-and-translate to a Swift macOS app
summary.what_it_does: SwaprTrans lets you select text in any input field, press Space (default trigger) to open a small translation popup, then press Enter to replace the original text with the translation in place. It uses Apple's on-device Translation.framework on macOS 15+ for offline translation, with Microsoft Edge and Google Translate as online alternatives. The popup is designed not to take focus. The core logic is packaged as SwaprTransKit, an open-source Swift Package. Other trigger options include right double-click, Option+D, Option+T and F1–F6.
notable: Replaces selected text in place on Enter, keeping cursor and context
Offline on-device translation via Apple Translation.framework on macOS 15+
Core library SwaprTransKit is open source as a Swift Package
caveats: Apple on-device translation requires macOS 15+ and a downloaded offline language pack
Gatekeeper may block first launch and require right-click Open
